title: pulumi-affected configuration
description: Optional. Everything is detected automatically; use this file for what analysis can't see.

stackPatterns.description: Stack patterns: "<project>/<stack>", where <project> is the project's name or its folder, a bare "<stack>" for that stack in every project, globs such as "accounts/*", or "all".

projects.description: Which Pulumi projects to consider. By default every folder with a Pulumi.yaml, outside node_modules.

stacks.description: Stacks that have no Pulumi.<stack>.yaml file, as "<project>/<stack>"

dependsOn.description: Dependencies analysis can't see, for example a stack that looks up another stack's resources in the cloud. Keys and values are stack patterns.

rules.description: Select stacks when files change in any way, even whitespace

inputs.description: Files a stack reads that analysis can't find, such as an asset whose path is computed. Keys are stack patterns; a change to a matching file's content selects the stack.

globalInputs.description: Files whose content change selects every stack. Default: .nvmrc and .node-version.

ignore.description: Preview differences that aren't real changes, e.g. a provider's assumeRole when previews run with a read-only role. Only updates are ever ignored.

properties.description: Top-level properties whose differences don't count; omit for all

command.description: How to run Pulumi for a stack; the run action appends preview or up arguments. Placeholders: {dir}, {stack}, {project}, {id}. Default: pulumi --cwd {dir} --stack {stack}

concurrency.description: How many stacks run at once. Default: 4

newStacks.description: Stacks that don't exist yet: preview them in a temporary local backend, where StackReferences, ESC environments and the real backend's secrets aren't available, or skip them. Default: preview

createStacks.description: Whether deploys create stacks that don't exist yet. Default: true; a stack whose config already has an encryption salt or key is never created again, since that points at the wrong backend.

failFast.description: Stop starting stacks after the first failure. Default: false, which keeps going and fails at the end

ignore.description: npm packages whose version changes never select a stack, as globs on the package name
